scope: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics, acquisition, resource costs, and bounded current-state evidence reviewed in Batch 427.
findings: 100-Ki Strike Super learned through Kid Gohan training. Current Xenoverse 2 documentation describes an upward semicircular headbutt/rush that is effective against airborne opponents and deals increased damage to knocked-back targets; source-reported damage is about 5% normally and up to 7% against a knocked-back target. Dragon Ball documentation independently confirms Kid Gohan's Lesson 1 acquisition endpoint.
unresolved: Exact startup, active, recovery, and movement distance remain unresolved.
The conditional damage figures are source-reported and not treated as patch-independent frame-derived values.
